warnings: PNG contains two portrait sheets rotated 90 degrees within one landscape scan; programmatically cropped to left/right halves and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. This file is the physical LEFT half (the higher-numbered sheet, แผ่นที่ 16/21), paired with แผ่นที่ 15/21 (3.1 close + 3.2 start, RIGHT half) extracted as _1.json.

This sheet's boilerplate header line (house name / แบบเลขที่ / กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง block) is visibly degraded in print quality on this specific sheet -- extra stray marks and partially-broken glyphs -- unlike every other sheet in this variant where the same header prints cleanly. The table body itself (ลำดับที่/รายการ/จำนวน/หน่วย columns) is unaffected and was transcribed at full confidence; only the boilerplate header is flagged, and sheet_name above uses the same clean canonical header text used on every other sheet rather than transcribing the degraded glyphs.

3.3.1's and 3.3.2's unit both print 'บ่อ' (pit/well) even though 3.3.2 (ถังดักไขมัน, a grease-trap tank) would more naturally read 'ถัง' (tank) -- re-checked, both genuinely print 'บ่อ'; recorded as printed rather than corrected.

This sheet closes both 3.2 (งานระบบท่อประปา) and 3.3 (ระบบสุขาภิบาลภายนอกอาคาร) with their own 'รวมข้อ' subtotal rows -- neither carries a grand 'รวมข้อ 3' total, which was already printed on the category-3 rollup sheet, บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_07_หน้า84_1_sanitary_summary_boq.json (แผ่นที่ 13/21).
All unit-price/amount columns are blank in the source for every row on this sheet -- transcribed as null, not invented.
All quantities re-verified at 3x zoom after rotating a programmatic crop of the left half (4, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1).
